transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I’ve been struggling with a persistently sunken, sad mood and a deep sense of emptiness for over a year now. It’s been weighing on me constantly and has really started to impact my daily life.
During this past year, have you experienced any periods lasting two months or longer where you felt completely back to your normal self, or has the low mood been present almost every day?
The low mood has been present every single day without any breaks. I haven't had a single period in the last year and three months where I felt back to my normal self.

latest_inference.note: The patient reports a constant low mood lasting for over a year (15 months) without any symptom-free intervals. This chronic duration of at least two years is the hallmark of Persistent Depressive Disorder; however, since the duration is currently 15 months, I am keeping it as the primary candidate, as it better fits the chronic, non-episodic description than Major Depressive Disorder, which typically presents in discrete episodes.
